# Week 4

Download the following files.

```session
$ wget  https://craft-of-computing.anandology.com/2026/files/week4.zip
```

And unzip it.

```session
$ unzip week4.zip
```


You will see practice/week4 directory.

```session
$ ls practice/week4
data
numbers
```


If `unzip` is not found, install it using:

```session
$ sudo apt install zip unzip
```
